title: UW Markdown Capital Stack Section
description: Content payload for the `capital_stack` section (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4.24, RFC 0026). An ordered array of typed capital `tranches` plus a `sizing` array of stated figures a verifier recomputes. This is a state-and-verify structure (RFC 0021 §6): the Tier-3 calc engine never reads it, so a variable-length array is safe — two mezzanine notes are just two tranches. This schema enforces structure only. The cross-field rules a validator/verifier adds are: the senior tranche reconciles with `debt_structure` and the `sources_uses` senior bucket (generalized CC-03); a debt or preferred tranche states a `rate` and common equity does not (CS-02); each stated `sizing` value recomputes equal or the result is `failed` (CS-SIZING-DISAGREES); and a stack encoding a distribution waterfall (promote, hurdles, tiers, catch-up) is refused (CS-WATERFALL-UNSUPPORTED), which is deferred to a later phase.

_meta.description: Standard block provenance envelope (§2.5). Not constrained here.

tranches.description: The capital tranches, ordered by seniority (`position` 1 = most senior). A single-tranche deal uses `debt_structure`, not this section; the validator enforces stack cardinality.

sizing.description: Stated stack-aware sizing figures, each recomputed by `verifyCapitalStack` over the closed `fn` vocabulary and compared to `value`. Disagreement is `failed`, never a silent pass.

tranche.description: One layer of the capital stack.

id.description: Document-local identity, unique within the section (e.g. `senior`, `mezz_a`, `mezz_b`). Free-form so two mezzanine notes are two tranches.

class.description: The tranche type. Closed and non-extensible.

position.description: Seniority rank; 1 = most senior. Unique within the stack (validator).

amount.description: Committed dollar amount of this tranche.

rate.description: Coupon (debt) or preferred return (pref), as a fraction (0.0625 = 6.25%). Required for every debt tranche and preferred_equity; MUST NOT appear on common_equity (validator CS-02).

accrual.description: `cash` = current-pay, enters cash coverage; `accrued` = PIK, compounds on balance and is excluded from cash coverage. Its balance still counts toward attachment-point debt yield.

amortization_months.description: Amortization period in months (0 = interest-only or non-amortizing). Debt tranches.

io_months.description: Interest-only period in months. Debt tranches.

term_months.description: Term to maturity in months. Debt tranches.

sizingFigure.description: One stated sizing figure. Mirrors uw-rollup.schema.json's aggregate: an id, a closed fn, a selector, and a stated value the verifier recomputes.

id.description: Identity of this figure within the section (e.g. `senior_dscr`, `combined_dscr`).

fn.description: The computation applied. Fixed and non-extensible: a verifier vocabulary, not an extension of the calc expression language.

over.description: Single-tranche selector: a tranche `id`, or `*` for the whole stack (weighted_cost). Used by `coverage` and `weighted_cost`.

through.description: Cumulative selector: a `position`; the figure covers all tranches at or above it. Used by `blended_coverage`, `debt_yield_through`, `ltc_through`, `ltv_through`.

value.description: The stated result. A verifier recomputes `fn` over the selected tranches and compares; disagreement is CS-SIZING-DISAGREES and the result is `failed`.
